entities.name: amending
entities.details: City Commission approved ordinance to amend St. Philip’s School site plan under Ordinance No. 3576, including replacing an existing building with a new pre-K building at 1109 Andalusia Avenue, Coral Gables, Florida; all other conditions of approval contained in Ordinance No. 3576 shall remain in effect.

entities.name: replace
entities.details: Replacement of an existing building with a new pre-K building at 1109 Andalusia Avenue, Coral Gables, Florida, as part of the amended site plan approved by the City Commission.

entities.name: remain in effect
entities.details: All other conditions of approval contained in Ordinance No. 3576 shall remain in effect following the amendment.

entities.name: sworn in
entities.details: City officials and speakers, including Mayor Vince Lago and others, participated in the swearing-in and approval process during the City Commission meeting.

entities.name: stand and raise your right hand
entities.details: Participants stood and raised their right hands during the oath-taking or ceremonial procedures at the City Commission meeting.

entities.name: swear or affirm
entities.details: City officials and speakers swore or affirmed their statements during the meeting, including the approval of the ordinance and related proceedings.
